set.body:
Outcome

Define the backend-independent scientific contract.

Acceptance

- Source axis identities, design semantics, measurement-frame identity, estimand, normalization, and requested boundaries determine plan identity.
- Storage, materialization, solver, chunking, parallelism, and seeds do not alter the estimand identity.
- Canonical encoding and equality laws are versioned and tested.
set.title: P2.1: define ScientificSpecification and ScientificPlanIdentity
